Sandbox_QuickMeals_ExcludedItems_tooltip: Items Quick Prepare never adds, as spices or as ingredients. Separate entries with ; or a comma. Use full ids (Base.Salt) or bare names (Salt). You can still add these by hand.
Sandbox_QuickMeals_SpiceLimitEnabled_too: When on, Quick Prepare stops adding spices once the meal holds the number set below. When off, it adds one of each available spice.
Sandbox_QuickMeals_SpiceLimit_tooltip: Most spices a meal can hold before Quick Prepare stops adding them, counting spices already in it. Only used when Limit spices is on.
